card.name: Section names in cross-references
card.fires_on: The last piece of a section title such as DRUG INTERACTIONS or ADVERSE REACTIONS inside a parenthetical cross-reference like (see ...). Also the section number in a bracketed reference.

modes.label: Section title ending
modes.description: Final piece of DRUG INTERACTIONS or ADVERSE REACTIONS after see or refer to.

modes.label: Bracketed section reference
modes.description: Part of a bracketed pointer to a numbered label section, such as Adverse Reactions or a section number.

card.plain: It marks the end of a section name in a pointer to another part of the drug label.
